Occurrences.Kwic: 七手八脚，神頭鬼面，棒打不開，刀割不斷。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X66/X66n1297.xml). The Mirror of the Chan Tradition preserves Yefu Daochuan’s same signed Diamond Sutra capping verse; Yefu Daochuan is the exact author of the retained line.

Senses.Explanation: Seven hands and eight feet depicts conspicuously many-limbed, disorderly activity. A rebuke exposes flustered conduct, while a direct answer and a capping verse deploy the same impossible-body image. The construction is evaluative or figurative in these cases; it does not assert a literal creature with seven hands and eight feet.
